Label: Total fertility rate 15-49
Definition: Total fertility rate for the three years preceding the survey for age group 15-49 expressed per woman

Label: Married women currently using any modern method of contraception
Definition: Percentage of currently married or in union women currently using any modern method of contraception
Level2: Current use of contraception by currently married women

Label: Neonatal mortality rate
Definition: Probability of dying in the first month of life in the five or ten years preceding the survey, per 1,000 live births. Estimates are given for ten year periods for all characteristics, but for five year periods only for the national total, by residence, and by sex.
Denominator: Per thousand children exposed in period in age group

Label: Under-five mortality rate
Definition: Probability of dying before the fifth birthday in the five or ten years preceding the survey, per 1,000 live births. Estimates are given for ten year periods for all characteristics, but for five year periods only for the national total, by residence, and by sex.
Denominator: Per thousand children exposed in period in age group

Label: Antenatal care from a skilled provider
Definition: Percentage of women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey who received antenatal care during the pregnancy for the most recent live birth from a skilled provider
Denominator: Women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey

Label: Antenatal visits for pregnancy: 4+ visits
Definition: Percentage of women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey who had 4+ antenatal care visits
Denominator: Women who had a live birth (or stillbirth) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey

Label: Place of delivery: Health facility
Definition: Percentage of live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey delivered at a health facility
Denominator: Live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey

Label: Assistance during delivery from a skilled provider
Definition: Percentage of live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey assisted by a skilled provider. Skilled provider includes doctor, nurse, midwife and auxiliary nurse or midwife.
Denominator: Live births (or stillbirths) in the two (or three/five) years preceding the survey

Label: Mother's first postnatal checkup in the first two days after birth
Definition: Percentage of women giving birth in the two years preceding the survey who had their first postnatal checkup within the first two days after birth
Denominator: Women giving birth in the two years preceding the survey
Level2: Timing of first postnatal checkup for the mother

Label: Fully vaccinated (8 basic antigens)
Definition: Percentage of children 12-23 (or 24-35) months who were fully vaccinated with 8 basic antigens (BCG, Polio 1-3, DPT 1-3, Measles)

Label: Received no vaccinations
Definition: Percentage of children 12-23 [or 24-35] months who had received no vaccinations

Label: Children stunted
Definition: Percentage of children stunted (below -2 SD of height for age according to the WHO standard)

Label: Children under 5 who slept under an insecticide-treated net (ITN)
Definition: Percentage of children under age five who slept under an insecticide treated net (ITN) the night before the survey
Level2: Use of mosquito nets by children

Label: Women who are literate
Definition: Percentage of women who are literate
